name: nutriscan-mobile
description: Apache Cordova Android wrapper for the NutriScan SPA

scripts.prepare:android: npm run build:web && npm run sync:www
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:android && cordova build android -- --packageType=apk
scripts.build:android:release: npm run prepare:android && cordova build android --release -- --packageType=apk
scripts.build:aab: npm run prepare:android && cordova build android --release -- --packageType=bundle
scripts.run:android: npm run prepare:android && cordova run android
